messages:
jamie: Quick question — when we sample auth telemetry for ratebanding/quotas, are we attributing to the original API key or the proxied service account?
leah: Right now the pipeline tags by auth_header->key_id before proxy. That gives us direct key usage counts but misses exchange/impersonation.
mario: That's true. The problem is customers using delegated SA through proxy all show under the proxy key which hides project attribution.
leah: We tried dual-tagging (origin_key + effective_identity) but storage/ingest costs doubled.
jamie: Our SLO for latency-sensitive dashboards says we should keep sampling low (<1%) to avoid query blowups. How do we expose meaningful per-project counters under that constraint?
sam: Idea: keep a small always-on sample for every unique key (e.g., 10 events/day) + a uniform sampling for high throughput streams. That keeps cardinality bounded and preserves attribution.
mario: I like that. Practically: prefix-based reservoir sampling per key_id. If key_id seen < N/day store everything, else 1% uniform.
leah: Implementation note: must ensure sampled events include routing decision metadata: routed_model, region, fallback_reason. Otherwise can’t debug SLO misses.
jamie: Also need the console UX: avoid adding a new per-key dropdown. Maybe add a badge on model route pages "sampled auth events: N/day" linking to filtered event view.
sam: Agreed. Plus a toggle for "include delegated identity" so users can opt into higher-cost attribution. Default off to control cost.
mario: We'll need a rollout plan: Stage 1 store origin_key + eff_id in a compact index (hash + small whitelist) for 10k most active keys. Stage 2 widen reservoir.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: telemetry-pipeline@staging -> v0.62.3 by ci/cd at 2026-03-22T17:04:12Z
leah: For quotas, meter enforcement must still use the authoritative key claim (post-exchange) not the sampled origin, otherwise you can undercount when proxy rewrites. Sampling must not affect billing decisions.
jamie: Right — sampled telemetry is for visibility only. Enforcement path remains the fast path with full attribution from the auth resolver.
sam: Can we include a small explainer in the console tooltip: "Visible metrics are sampled for cost reasons; billing uses authoritative counters" — reduces support tickets.
mario: Ops question: what retention for sampled events? 30 days? 90? Longer helps regressions but costs multiply.
leah: Proposal: 30 days standard, 90 days for keys flagged as "billing discrep" while we investigate.
jamie: Ok action items: leah prototype reservoir sampler + compact eff_id index (PR by Fri). sam add console badge + toggle copy. mario write rollout doc with stages + expected cost delta. I'll sync with billing on retention policy.
leah: I'll drop a short PR description in #eng-releases when ready.
jamie: Thanks everyone — this should let us keep low sampling while preserving useful attribution for SLO/debugging. :thumbsup:
